-- Keep the original supplied v3 head texture.
BLEED_PACKS["v3"].headTexture =
    "http://www.roblox.com/asset/?id=133940918"

local function saveAccessoryOriginalOutfit(char)
    if not char then
        return
    end

    local shirt = char:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("Shirt")
    local pants = char:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("Pants")

    _G.Lust.OriginalOutfit.shirt =
        shirt and shirt.ShirtTemplate or nil

    _G.Lust.OriginalOutfit.pants =
        pants and pants.PantsTemplate or nil
end

local function restoreAccessoryOriginalOutfit(char)
    if not char then
        return
    end

    for _, obj in ipairs(char:GetChildren()) do
        if obj:IsA("Shirt") or obj:IsA("Pants") then
            pcall(function()
                obj:Destroy()
            end)
        end
    end

    if _G.Lust.OriginalOutfit.shirt then
        local newShirt = Instance.new("Shirt")
        newShirt.ShirtTemplate = _G.Lust.OriginalOutfit.shirt
        newShirt.Parent = char
    end

    if _G.Lust.OriginalOutfit.pants then
        local newPants = Instance.new("Pants")
        newPants.PantsTemplate = _G.Lust.OriginalOutfit.pants
        newPants.Parent = char
    end

    _G.Lust.OriginalOutfit.shirt = nil
    _G.Lust.OriginalOutfit.pants = nil
end

local function clearAccessoryOutfit(char)
    if not char then
        return
    end

    for _, obj in ipairs(char:GetChildren()) do
        if obj:IsA("Shirt") or obj:IsA("Pants") then
            pcall(function()
                obj:Destroy()
            end)
        end
    end
end

local function saveAccessoryOriginals(char)
    _G.Lust.OriginalAccessories = {}

    if not char then
        return
    end

    for _, child in ipairs(char:GetChildren()) do
        if child:IsA("Accessory") or child:IsA("Hat") then
            local ok, clone = pcall(function()
                return child:Clone()
            end)

            if ok and clone then
                table.insert(_G.Lust.OriginalAccessories, clone)
            end
        end
    end
end

local function restoreAccessoryOriginals(char)
    if not char then
        return
    end

    for _, child in ipairs(char:GetChildren()) do
        if child:IsA("Accessory")
            or child:IsA("Hat")
            or child.Name == "AuFfitAccessory"
            or child.Name:find("Korblox_")
            or child.Name:find("Headless_") then

            pcall(function()
                child:Destroy()
            end)
        end
    end

    local partsToRestore = {
        "Head",
        "LeftUpperLeg",
        "LeftLowerLeg",
        "LeftFoot",
        "RightUpperLeg",
        "RightLowerLeg",
        "RightFoot",
    }

    for _, partName in ipairs(partsToRestore) do
        local part = char:FindFirstChild(partName)

        if part and part:IsA("BasePart") then
            pcall(function()
                part.Transparency = 0
            end)
        end
    end

    local head = char:FindFirstChild("Head")

    if head and head:IsA("BasePart") then
        pcall(function()
            head.Transparency = 0
        end)
    end

    for _, clone in ipairs(_G.Lust.OriginalAccessories) do
        if clone and clone.Parent == nil then
            local ok, newAcc = pcall(function()
                return clone:Clone()
            end)

            if ok and newAcc then
                newAcc.Parent = char

                for _, weld in ipairs(newAcc:GetDescendants()) do
                    if weld:IsA("Weld")
                        or weld:IsA("WeldConstraint") then

                        local part0Name =
                            weld.Part0 and weld.Part0.Name

                        local part1Name =
                            weld.Part1 and weld.Part1.Name

                        if part0Name then
                            local newPart0 =
                                char:FindFirstChild(part0Name)

                            if newPart0 then
                                pcall(function()
                                    weld.Part0 = newPart0
                                end)
                            end
                        end

                        if part1Name then
                            local newPart1 =
                                char:FindFirstChild(part1Name)

                            if newPart1 then
                                pcall(function()
                                    weld.Part1 = newPart1
                                end)
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end

    _G.Lust.OriginalAccessories = {}
end

local function clearAccessoryItems(char)
    if not char then
        return
    end

    for _, child in ipairs(char:GetChildren()) do
        if child:IsA("Accessory")
            or child:IsA("Hat")
            or child.Name == "AuFfitAccessory"
            or child.Name:find("Korblox_")
            or child.Name:find("Headless_") then

            pcall(function()
                child:Destroy()
            end)
        end
    end

    for _, partName in ipairs({
        "Head",
        "LeftUpperLeg",
        "LeftLowerLeg",
        "LeftFoot",
        "RightUpperLeg",
        "RightLowerLeg",
        "RightFoot",
    }) do
        local part = char:FindFirstChild(partName)

        if part and part:IsA("BasePart") then
            pcall(function()
                part.Transparency = 0
            end)
        end
    end
end

local function loadAccessoryAsset(assetId)
    local ok, objects = pcall(function()
        return game:GetObjects(
            "rbxassetid://" .. tostring(assetId)
        )
    end)

    if ok
        and typeof(objects) == "table"
        and #objects > 0 then
        return objects
    end

    ok, objects = pcall(function()
        return InsertService:LoadAsset(assetId)
    end)

    if ok and objects then
        return {objects}
    end

    return nil
end

local function applyBleedOutfit(packName)
    local config = BLEED_PACKS[packName]

    if not config then
        return false
    end

    local char = player.Character

    if not char then
        return false
    end

    local head =
        char:FindFirstChild("Head")
        or char:WaitForChild("Head", 10)

    if not head then
        return false
    end

    -- Head mesh + texture
    if config.headMesh then
        for _, d in ipairs(char:GetChildren()) do
            if d:IsA("CharacterMesh")
                and d.BodyPart == Enum.BodyPart.Head then

                pcall(function()
                    d:Destroy()
                end)
            end
        end

        local done = false

        if head:IsA("MeshPart") then
            done = pcall(function()
                head.MeshId = config.headMesh

                if config.headTexture then
                    head.TextureID = config.headTexture
                end
            end)
        end

        if not done then
            local sm =
                head:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("SpecialMesh")
                or Instance.new("SpecialMesh")

            sm.Parent = head
            sm.MeshType = Enum.MeshType.FileMesh
            sm.MeshId = config.headMesh
            sm.TextureId = config.headTexture or ""
        end
    end

    -- Shirt
    if config.shirt then
        local s =
            char:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("Shirt")
            or Instance.new("Shirt")

        s.Name = "Shirt"
        s.ShirtTemplate = config.shirt
        s.Parent = char
    end

    -- Pants
    if config.pants then
        local p =
            char:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("Pants")
            or Instance.new("Pants")

        p.Name = "Pants"
        p.PantsTemplate = config.pants
        p.Parent = char
    end

    -- Main accessory
    if config.accessory then
        local old = char:FindFirstChild("AuFfitAccessory")

        if old then
            pcall(function()
                old:Destroy()
            end)
        end

        local objs = loadAccessoryAsset(config.accessory)

        if objs then
            local handle

            for _, o in ipairs(objs) do
                if o:IsA("BasePart") then
                    handle = o
                    break
                end

                local f =
                    o:FindFirstChildWhichIsA(
                        "BasePart",
                        true
                    )

                if f then
                    handle = f
                    break
                end
            end

            if handle then
                local h = handle:Clone()

                h.Name = "AuFfitAccessory"
                h.CanCollide = false
                h.Anchored = false
                h.Massless = true
                h.Parent = char

                local weld = Instance.new("Weld")

                weld.Part0 = head
                weld.Part1 = h
                weld.C0 =
                    CFrame.new(
                        config.offset or Vector3.zero
                    )

                weld.Parent = h
            end

            for _, o in ipairs(objs) do
                pcall(function()
                    o:Destroy()
                end)
            end
        end
    end

    -- Korblox
    if config.korblox
        and config.korblox ~= "none" then

        local ids = {
            left = 139607673,
            right = 139607718,
        }

        local targets = {
            left = "LeftUpperLeg",
            right = "RightUpperLeg",
        }

        local hides = {
            left = {
                "LeftUpperLeg",
                "LeftLowerLeg",
                "LeftFoot",
            },

            right = {
                "RightUpperLeg",
                "RightLowerLeg",
                "RightFoot",
            },
        }

        local function attachKorblox(side)
            local targetPart =
                char:FindFirstChild(targets[side])

            if not targetPart then
                return false
            end

            for _, partName in ipairs(hides[side]) do
                local limb = char:FindFirstChild(partName)

                if limb and limb:IsA("BasePart") then
                    pcall(function()
                        limb.Transparency = 1
                    end)
                end
            end

            local success, objects = pcall(function()
                return game:GetObjects(
                    "rbxassetid://" .. ids[side]
                )
            end)

            if not success
                or not objects
                or #objects == 0 then
                return false
            end

            local assetModel = objects[1]

            local mainMesh =
                assetModel:IsA("BasePart")
                and assetModel
                or assetModel:FindFirstChildWhichIsA(
                    "BasePart",
                    true
                )

            if not mainMesh then
                pcall(function()
                    assetModel:Destroy()
                end)
                return false
            end

            mainMesh.Name = "Korblox_" .. side
            mainMesh.CanCollide = false
            mainMesh.Massless = true
            mainMesh.CFrame = targetPart.CFrame

            local weld = Instance.new("WeldConstraint")

            weld.Part0 = targetPart
            weld.Part1 = mainMesh
            weld.Parent = mainMesh

            assetModel.Parent = char

            return true
        end

        if config.korblox == "left" then
            attachKorblox("left")
        elseif config.korblox == "right" then
            attachKorblox("right")
        end
    end

    return true
end

local function applyAccessoryPack(packName)
    local char = player.Character

    if not char then
        return false
    end

    if packName == "Off" then
        currentAccessoryPack = "Off"

        if accSelectorLabel then
            accSelectorLabel.Text = "Off"
        end

        clearAccessoryItems(char)
        restoreAccessoryOriginalOutfit(char)
        restoreAccessoryOriginals(char)

        return true
    end

    if not _G.Lust.OriginalOutfit.shirt
        and not _G.Lust.OriginalOutfit.pants then

        saveAccessoryOriginalOutfit(char)
    end

    if #_G.Lust.OriginalAccessories == 0 then
        saveAccessoryOriginals(char)
    end

    clearAccessoryOutfit(char)
    clearAccessoryItems(char)

    local ok = applyBleedOutfit(packName)

    if ok then
        currentAccessoryPack = packName
        M.accessoryPackName = packName

        if accSelectorLabel then
            accSelectorLabel.Text = packName
        end
    end

    return ok
end

local function setAccessoryPackEnabled(state)
    state = state == true
    M.accessoryPackEnabled = state

    if state then
        return applyAccessoryPack(
            M.accessoryPackName or "v1"
        )
    else
        return applyAccessoryPack("Off")
    end
end

-- Public API
M.Packs = BLEED_PACKS
M.Order = ACCESSORY_PACK_ORDER
M.Apply = applyAccessoryPack
M.SetEnabled = setAccessoryPackEnabled

function M.Next()
    local idx = 1

    for i, entry in ipairs(ACCESSORY_PACK_ORDER) do
        if entry[2] == currentAccessoryPack then
            idx = i
            break
        end
    end

    local newIdx = idx + 1

    if newIdx > #ACCESSORY_PACK_ORDER then
        newIdx = 1
    end

    local name = ACCESSORY_PACK_ORDER[newIdx][2]

    if name == "Off" then
        M.accessoryPackEnabled = false
    else
        M.accessoryPackName = name
        M.accessoryPackEnabled = true
    end

    return applyAccessoryPack(name)
end

function M.Previous()
    local idx = 1

    for i, entry in ipairs(ACCESSORY_PACK_ORDER) do
        if entry[2] == currentAccessoryPack then
            idx = i
            break
        end
    end

    local newIdx = idx - 1

    if newIdx < 1 then
        newIdx = #ACCESSORY_PACK_ORDER
    end

    local name = ACCESSORY_PACK_ORDER[newIdx][2]

    if name == "Off" then
        M.accessoryPackEnabled = false
    else
        M.accessoryPackName = name
        M.accessoryPackEnabled = true
    end

    return applyAccessoryPack(name)
end

function M.Toggle()
    return setAccessoryPackEnabled(
        not M.accessoryPackEnabled
    )
end

function M.GetCurrent()
    return currentAccessoryPack
end

function M.GetEnabled()
    return M.accessoryPackEnabled == true
end

function M.SetLabel(label)
    accSelectorLabel = label

    if accSelectorLabel then
        accSelectorLabel.Text = currentAccessoryPack
    end
end

function M.SetPack(packName)
    if not BLEED_PACKS[packName] then
        return false
    end

    M.accessoryPackName = packName

    if M.accessoryPackEnabled then
        return applyAccessoryPack(packName)
    end

    return true
end

_G.AccessoryPack = {
    Packs = BLEED_PACKS,
    Order = ACCESSORY_PACK_ORDER,
    Apply = applyAccessoryPack,
    SetEnabled = setAccessoryPackEnabled,
    Next = M.Next,
    Previous = M.Previous,
    Toggle = M.Toggle,
    GetCurrent = M.GetCurrent,
    GetEnabled = M.GetEnabled,
    SetLabel = M.SetLabel,
    SetPack = M.SetPack,
    _respawnConn = M._respawnConn,
}

-- Re-apply after respawn when enabled.
M._respawnConn =
    player.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(char)
        if not M.accessoryPackEnabled then
            return
        end

        task.spawn(function()
            char:WaitForChild("Humanoid", 10)
            task.wait(0.35)

            if player.Character ~= char
                or not M.accessoryPackEnabled then
                return
            end

            _G.Lust.OriginalOutfit = {
                shirt = nil,
                pants = nil,
            }

            _G.Lust.OriginalAccessories = {}

            pcall(function()
                applyAccessoryPack(
                    M.accessoryPackName or "v1"
                )
            end)
        end)
    end)



    local Categories={"Speed","Combat","Movement","Visual","Settings"}
    local CategoryMeta={
        Speed={icon="SP",sub="velocity"}, Combat={icon="CB",sub="targeting"},
        Movement={icon="MV",sub="routing"}, Visual={icon="FX",sub="display"}, Settings={icon="ST",sub="safety"},
    }
    local CategoryRefs={contents={},btns={},strokes={},active="Speed"}

    
    for pageIndex,name in ipairs(Categories) do
        local page=Instance.new("Frame")
        page.Size=UDim2.new(1,0,0,0); page.AutomaticSize=Enum.AutomaticSize.Y; page.BackgroundTransparency=1
        page.Visible=(name=="Speed"); page.LayoutOrder=pageIndex; page.Parent=CF; CategoryRefs.contents[name]=page
        local lay=Instance.new("UIListLayout"); lay.SortOrder=Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder; lay.Padding=UDim.new(0,5); lay.Parent=page
        local pad=Instance.new("UIPadding"); pad.PaddingLeft=UDim.new(0,4); pad.PaddingRight=UDim.new(0,4)
        pad.PaddingTop=UDim.new(0,6); pad.PaddingBottom=UDim.new(0,6); pad.Parent=page
    end

    
    local _CAT_COUNT=#Categories
    for i,name in ipairs(Categories) do
        local isActive=(name=="Speed")

        local meta=CategoryMeta[name]
        local row=Instance.new("Frame",TabRail)
        row.Name="Tab_"..name
        row.Size=UDim2.new(1,-10,0,36)
        row.BackgroundColor3=isActive and Color3.fromRGB(24,24,31) or Color3.fromRGB(10,10,15)
        row.BackgroundTransparency=isActive and 0.05 or 0.55
        row.BorderSizePixel=0; row.LayoutOrder=i*2; row.ClipsDescendants=false; row.ZIndex=10; row.Active=false
        guiCorner(row,9)
        local rowStroke=guiStroke(row,isActive and _ACC.accentDark or Color3.fromRGB(35,36,48),1)
        CategoryRefs.strokes[name]=rowStroke

        
        local ind=Instance.new("Frame",row); ind.Name="indicator"
        ind.AnchorPoint=Vector2.new(0,0.5); ind.Position=UDim2.new(0,0,0.5,0)
        ind.BackgroundColor3=_ACC.accent
        ind.BackgroundTransparency=isActive and 0 or 1
        ind.Size=isActive and UDim2.new(0,3,0,28) or UDim2.new(0,3,0,14)
        ind.BorderSizePixel=0; guiCorner(ind,2)
        table.insert(_themeTabInds,ind)

        local badge=Instance.new("Frame",row)
        badge.Name="Badge"
        badge.Size=UDim2.new(0,28,0,28); badge.Position=UDim2.new(0,10,0.5,-14)
        badge.BackgroundColor3=isActive and _ACC.accentBg or Color3.fromRGB(19,19,26)
        badge.BackgroundTransparency=0.08; badge.BorderSizePixel=0; guiCorner(badge,7)
        local badgeStroke=guiStroke(badge,isActive and _ACC.accentDark or Color3.fromRGB(48,49,62),1)
        local badgeText=Instance.new("TextLabel",badge)
        badgeText.Size=UDim2.new(1,0,1,0); badgeText.BackgroundTransparency=1
        badgeText.Text=meta.icon; badgeText.Font=Enum.Font.GothamBlack; badgeText.TextSize=9
        badgeText.TextColor3=isActive and _ACC.accent or Color3.fromRGB(112,114,132)

        local sub=Instance.new("TextLabel",row)
        sub.Size=UDim2.new(1,-48,0,12); sub.Position=UDim2.new(0,45,0,25)
        sub.BackgroundTransparency=1; sub.Text=meta.sub; sub.Font=Enum.Font.Gotham
        sub.TextSize=8; sub.TextColor3=Color3.fromRGB(82,84,102); sub.TextXAlignment=Enum.TextXAlignment.Left

        
        local btn=Instance.new("TextButton",row)
        btn.Size=UDim2.new(1,-45,0,22); btn.Position=UDim2.new(0,45,0,6)
        btn.BackgroundTransparency=1
        btn.Text=name
        btn.TextColor3=isActive and Color3.fromRGB(240,240,255) or Color3.fromRGB(138,140,158)
        btn.Font=Enum.Font.GothamBold; btn.TextSize=10; btn.TextXAlignment=Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
        btn.AutoButtonColor=false; btn.BorderSizePixel=0
        btn.TextWrapped=true; btn.TextTruncate=Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd
        table.insert(_themeTabBtns,{btn=btn,name=name})
        CategoryRefs.btns[name]=btn

        

        btn.MouseEnter:Connect(function()
            if CategoryRefs.active~=name then
                local ti=TweenInfo.new(0.18,Enum.EasingStyle.Quint,Enum.EasingDirection.Out)
                tw(btn,{TextColor3=Color3.fromRGB(225,228,240)},ti)
                tw(row,{BackgroundTransparency=0.18,BackgroundColor3=Color3.fromRGB(18,18,25)},ti)
                tw(badgeText,{TextColor3=Color3.fromRGB(190,192,210)},ti)
            end
        end)
        btn.MouseLeave:Connect(function()
            if CategoryRefs.active~=name then
                local ti=TweenInfo.new(0.22,Enum.EasingStyle.Quint,Enum.EasingDirection.Out)
                tw(btn,{TextColor3=Color3.fromRGB(138,140,158)},ti)
                tw(row,{BackgroundTransparency=0.42,BackgroundColor3=Color3.fromRGB(10,10,15)},ti)
                tw(badgeText,{TextColor3=Color3.fromRGB(112,114,132)},ti)

            if CategoryRefs.active == name then return end
            _tabClicking = true
            task.delay(0.12, function() _tabClicking = false end)

            local lay = newPage:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIListLayout")
            if lay then

            for n,b in pairs(CategoryRefs.btns) do
                local ac=(n==name)
                tw(b, {TextColor3=ac and Color3.fromRGB(240,240,255) or Color3.fromRGB(138,140,158)}, ti_btn)

                tw(r2, {BackgroundTransparency=ac and 0.08 or 0.42,BackgroundColor3=ac and Color3.fromRGB(24,24,31) or Color3.fromRGB(10,10,15)}, ti_btn)
                local ind2=r2:FindFirstChild("indicator")
                if ind2 then tw(ind2, {BackgroundTransparency=ac and 0 or 1, Size=ac and UDim2.new(0,3,0,28) or UDim2.new(0,3,0,14)}, ti_ind) end
                local badge2=r2:FindFirstChild("Badge")
                if badge2 then

                    tw(badge2,{BackgroundColor3=ac and _ACC.accentBg or Color3.fromRGB(19,19,26)},ti_btn)

                end
                local stroke2=CategoryRefs.strokes[n]
                if stroke2 then stroke2.Color=ac and _ACC.accentDark or Color3.fromRGB(35,36,48) end
            end
        end
        btn.Activated:Connect(switchToThisTab)
        local hit=Instance.new("TextButton",row)
        hit.Name="TabHit"
        hit.Size=UDim2.fromScale(1,1)
        hit.BackgroundTransparency=1
        hit.Text=""
        hit.ZIndex=15
        hit.Active=true
        hit.AutoButtonColor=false
        hit.Activated:Connect(switchToThisTab)
        -- No InputEnded fallback here: it was changing tabs during touch-scrolls.
    end

    
    do
        local spBtn=CategoryRefs.btns["Speed"]
        if spBtn then
            spBtn.TextColor3=_ACC.accent
            local r2=spBtn.Parent
            r2.BackgroundTransparency=0.08
            local ind2=r2:FindFirstChild("indicator")
            if ind2 then ind2.BackgroundTransparency=0; ind2.Size=UDim2.new(0,3,0,28) end
        end
    end

    -- ============ MORNEX BAT SKINS (integrated) ============
    do
        local MB_SAVE="MornexBatSkins.json"
        local MB_SKINS={
            {name="None"},
            {name="Katana"},
            {name="Scythe",assetId="8699386664"},
            {name="Ban Hammer",assetId="14701192921"},
        }
        local MB_ADJUST={
            Katana={x=.09,y=.5,z=.55,rx=18,ry=-180,rz=95,scale=5.5},
            Scythe={x=.09,y=-1,z=-.8,rx=0,ry=-90,rz=0,scale=6},
            ["Ban Hammer"]={x=0,y=-1,z=0,rx=0,ry=180,rz=0,scale=4},
        }
        local MB_SOUND={
            Katana="rbxassetid://111808555599832",
            Scythe="rbxassetid://111808555599832",
            ["Ban Hammer"]="rbxassetid://137964779511233",
        }
        local MB_RED=Color3.fromRGB(200,0,0)
        local MB_STATE={enabled=true,skin="Katana"}

        local function mbLoad()
            if not(isfile and isfile(MB_SAVE)) then return end
            pcall(function()
                local d=HS:JSONDecode(readfile(MB_SAVE))
                if type(d)=="table" then
                    if d.enabled~=nil then MB_STATE.enabled=d.enabled end
                    if d.skin then MB_STATE.skin=tostring(d.skin) end
                end
            end)
        end
        local function mbSave()
            pcall(function() if writefile then writefile(MB_SAVE,HS:JSONEncode(MB_STATE)) end end)
        end
        mbLoad()

        local function mbIsBat(t)
            if not(t and t:IsA("Tool")) then return false end
            local n=t.Name:lower()
            return n:find("bat")~=nil or n:find("slap")~=nil
        end
        local function mbHandle(t)
            return t and (t:FindFirstChild("Handle") or t:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart",true))
        end
        local function mbClear(t)
            if not t then return end
            for _,d in ipairs(t:GetDescendants()) do
                if d.Name:match("^MornexBatSkin_") then pcall(function() d:Destroy() end)
                elseif d:IsA("BasePart") then
                    pcall(function() d.LocalTransparencyModifier=0;d.Transparency=0;d.CastShadow=true end)
                elseif d:IsA("Decal") or d:IsA("Texture") then pcall(function() d.Transparency=0 end)
                elseif d:IsA("Trail") or d:IsA("Beam") or d:IsA("ParticleEmitter") then pcall(function() d.Enabled=true end) end
            end
        end
        local function mbHide(t)
            for _,d in ipairs(t:GetDescendants()) do
                if not d.Name:match("^MornexBatSkin_") then
                    if d:IsA("BasePart") then pcall(function() d.LocalTransparencyModifier=1;d.Transparency=1;d.CastShadow=false end)
                    elseif d:IsA("Decal") or d:IsA("Texture") then pcall(function() d.Transparency=1 end)
                    elseif d:IsA("Trail") or d:IsA("Beam") or d:IsA("ParticleEmitter") then pcall(function() d.Enabled=false end) end
                end
            end
        end
        local function mbPart(parent,name,size,color,mat,shape)
            local p=Instance.new("Part");p.Name="MornexBatSkin_"..name;p.Size=size;p.Color=color
            p.Material=mat or Enum.Material.Neon;p.Shape=shape or Enum.PartType.Block
            p.Anchored=false;p.CanCollide=false;p.CanTouch=false;p.CanQuery=false;p.Massless=true;p.Parent=parent
            return p
        end
        local function mbWeld(a,b,cf)
            b.CFrame=a.CFrame*(cf or CFrame.new())
            local w=Instance.new("WeldConstraint");w.Name="MornexBatSkin_Weld";w.Part0=a;w.Part1=b;w.Parent=b
        end
        local function mbKatana(t)
            local h=mbHandle(t);if not h then return false end
            mbClear(t);mbHide(t)
            local f=Instance.new("Folder");f.Name="MornexBatSkin_Katana";f.Parent=t
            local blade=mbPart(f,"Blade",Vector3.new(.3,4.7,.06),Color3.fromRGB(168,181,190),Enum.Material.Metal)
            mbWeld(h,blade,CFrame.new(.045,2.58,0))
            mbWeld(h,mbPart(f,"Edge",Vector3.new(.06,4.7,.066),Color3.fromRGB(224,232,238),Enum.Material.Metal),CFrame.new(.155,2.5,-.004))
            local tip=Instance.new("WedgePart");tip.Name="MornexBatSkin_Tip";tip.Size=Vector3.new(.3,.4,.06);tip.Color=Color3.fromRGB(185,198,206);tip.Material=Enum.Material.Metal;tip.Anchored=false;tip.CanCollide=false;tip.Massless=true;tip.Parent=f
            mbWeld(h,tip,CFrame.new(.045,5.1,0)*CFrame.Angles(0,0,math.rad(30)))
            local ham=mbPart(f,"Hamon",Vector3.new(.032,3.8,.062),MB_RED,Enum.Material.Neon);ham.Transparency=.18;mbWeld(h,ham,CFrame.new(.135,2.6,-.009))
            mbWeld(h,mbPart(f,"Guard",Vector3.new(1.05,.1,.36),Color3.fromRGB(80,14,16),Enum.Material.Metal),CFrame.new(0,.35,0))
            mbWeld(h,mbPart(f,"Grip",Vector3.new(.31,1.02,.31),Color3.fromRGB(12,10,15),Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic,Enum.PartType.Cylinder),CFrame.new(0,-.5,0))
            for i=1,6 do mbWeld(h,mbPart(f,"Wrap"..i,i%2==0 and Vector3.new(.335,.035,.335) or Vector3.new(.335,.035,.335),i%2==0 and Color3.fromRGB(140,0,0) or Color3.fromRGB(30,18,30),Enum.Material.Metal,Enum.PartType.Cylinder),CFrame.new(0,-.93+i*.145,0)) end
            mbWeld(h,mbPart(f,"Pommel",Vector3.new(.36,.16,.36),Color3.fromRGB(80,14,16),Enum.Material.Metal,Enum.PartType.Ball),CFrame.new(0,-1.1,0))
            return true
        end
        local function mbAsset(t,id)
            local h=mbHandle(t);if not h then return false end
            mbClear(t);mbHide(t)
            local ok,objs=pcall(function() return game:GetObjects("rbxassetid://"..id) end)
            if not ok or not objs or not objs[1] then return false end
            local c=objs[1]:Clone();c.Name="MornexBatSkin_Asset"
            for _,d in ipairs(c:GetDescendants()) do
                if d:IsA("Script") or d:IsA("LocalScript") or d:IsA("ModuleScript") or d:IsA("ScreenGui") or d:IsA("BillboardGui") then pcall(function() d:Destroy() end) end
            end
            local box=Instance.new("Folder");box.Name="MornexBatSkin_Asset";box.Parent=t
            local model
            if c:IsA("Model") then model=c;model.Parent=box else model=Instance.new("Model");model.Name="MornexBatSkin_Model";model.Parent=box;c.Parent=model end
            local parts={}
            for _,d in ipairs(model:GetDescendants()) do if d:IsA("BasePart") then table.insert(parts,d);d.Anchored=false;d.CanCollide=false;d.Massless=true end end
            if #parts==0 then model:Destroy();return false end
            local a=MB_ADJUST[MB_STATE.skin] or MB_ADJUST.Katana
            local _,bs=model:GetBoundingBox();local longest=math.max(bs.X,bs.Y,bs.Z)
            if longest>0 then pcall(function() model:ScaleTo(math.clamp((a.scale or 5)/longest,.05,8)) end) end
            local _,b2=model:GetBoundingBox();local o=CFrame.new()
            if b2.X>b2.Y and b2.X>b2.Z then o=CFrame.Angles(0,0,math.rad(90)) elseif b2.Z>b2.Y and b2.Z>b2.X then o=CFrame.Angles(math.rad(90),0,0) end
            pcall(function() model:PivotTo(h.CFrame*CFrame.new(a.x or 0,a.y or 0,a.z or 0)*o*CFrame.Angles(math.rad(a.rx or 0),math.rad(a.ry or 0),math.rad(a.rz or 0))) end)
            for _,p in ipairs(parts) do local w=Instance.new("WeldConstraint");w.Name="MornexBatSkin_Weld";w.Part0=h;w.Part1=p;w.Parent=p end
            return true
        end
        local function mbApply(t)
            if not mbIsBat(t) then return end
            if not MB_STATE.enabled or MB_STATE.skin=="None" then mbClear(t);return end
            local entry
            for _,v in ipairs(MB_SKINS) do if v.name==MB_STATE.skin then entry=v break end end
            if not entry then MB_STATE.skin="Katana";entry=MB_SKINS[2] end
            local ok
            if entry.name=="Katana" then ok=mbKatana(t) elseif entry.assetId then ok=mbAsset(t,entry.assetId) end
            if ok then
                local sid=MB_SOUND[entry.name]
                if sid then for _,d in ipairs(t:GetDescendants()) do if d:IsA("Sound") then pcall(function() d.SoundId=sid end) end end end
            end
        end
        local function mbRefresh()
            local bags={}
            if player.Character then table.insert(bags,player.Character) end
            local bp=player:FindFirstChildOfClass("Backpack");if bp then table.insert(bags,bp) end
            for _,bag in ipairs(bags) do for _,ch in ipairs(bag:GetChildren()) do if mbIsBat(ch) then pcall(mbApply,ch) end end end
        end
        _GACC.MornexBatSkinRefresh=mbRefresh
        _GACC.MornexBatSkinSet=function(name,on)
            MB_STATE.skin=name or MB_STATE.skin;MB_STATE.enabled=on~=false;mbSave();mbRefresh()
        end
        player.CharacterAdded:Connect(function() task.wait(.6);mbRefresh() end)
        local bp=player:FindFirstChildOfClass("Backpack")
        if bp then bp.ChildAdded:Connect(function(ch) if mbIsBat(ch) then task.wait(.1);mbApply(ch) end end) end
        player.ChildAdded:Connect(function(ch) if ch:IsA("Backpack") then ch.ChildAdded:Connect(function(x) if mbIsBat(x) then task.wait(.1);mbApply(x) end end) end end)
        mbRefresh()
        _GACC.MornexBatSkinNames={"None","Katana","Scythe","Ban Hammer"}
        _GACC.MornexBatSkinCurrent=function() return MB_STATE.skin end
        _GACC.MornexBatSkinEnabled=function() return MB_STATE.enabled end
    end

    -- Compact Bat Skin selector: one small row, no separate floating tab.
    do

        local lbl=Instance.new("TextLabel",row);lbl.Size=UDim2.new(0,90,1,0);lbl.Position=UDim2.new(0,14,0,0)
        lbl.BackgroundTransparency=1;lbl.Text="Bat Skin";lbl.TextColor3=Color3.fromRGB(255,255,255);lbl.TextSize=11;lbl.Font=Enum.Font.GothamBold;lbl.TextXAlignment=Enum.TextXAlignment.Left

    local function syncStealSettingRows(animate)
        for _,entry in ipairs({{radiusRow,true},{durationRow,true},{semiRangeRow,false},{primeRangeRow,false}}) do
            local settingRow=entry[1];local wantsNormal=entry[2];local show=(stealMode=="normal")==wantsNormal
            if settingRow then
                if show then
                    settingRow.Visible=true
                    if animate then
                        settingRow.Size=UDim2.new(1,0,0,0)
                        tw(settingRow,{Size=UDim2.new(1,0,0,42)},TweenInfo.new(0.22,Enum.EasingStyle.Quint,Enum.EasingDirection.Out))
                    else
                        settingRow.Size=UDim2.new(1,0,0,42)
                    end
                elseif animate then
                    tw(settingRow,{Size=UDim2.new(1,0,0,0)},TweenInfo.new(0.16,Enum.EasingStyle.Quint,Enum.EasingDirection.In))
                    task.delay(0.17,function() if settingRow and ((stealMode=="normal")~=wantsNormal) then settingRow.Visible=false end end)
                else
                    settingRow.Visible=false
                end
            end
        end
    end

    applyColorTheme = function(name)
        local thm = THEME_DEFS[name]; if not thm then return end
        currentColorTheme = name
        
        _ACC.accent=thm.accent; _ACC.accentDark=thm.accentDark
        _ACC.accentBg=thm.accentBg; _ACC.accentHover=thm.accentHover
        _ACC.accentRowHover=thm.accentRowHover
        
        _GACC.accent=thm.accent; _GACC.accentDark=thm.accentDark
        _GACC.accentBg=thm.accentBg; _GACC.accentHover=thm.accentHover
        _GACC.accentRowHover=thm.accentRowHover
        
        for _,_r in ipairs(_themeExtRefs) do pcall(_r.callback,thm) end
        
        C.blue=thm.accent; C.accent=thm.accent; C.accentDark=thm.accentDark
        C.accentBg=thm.accentBg; C.accentHover=thm.accentHover; C.accentRowHover=thm.accentRowHover
        
        for _,f in ipairs(_themeSeps)       do pcall(function() f.BackgroundColor3=thm.accent end) end
        for _,f in ipairs(_themeScrollbars) do pcall(function() f.ScrollBarImageColor3=thm.accent end) end
        for _,r in ipairs(_themeSectRefs)   do
            pcall(function() r.arrow.TextColor3=thm.accent end)
            pcall(function() r.lbl.TextColor3=thm.accentDark end)
        end
        for _,tb in ipairs(_themeTabBtns) do
            pcall(function()
                local ac=(CategoryRefs.active==tb.name)
                tb.btn.TextColor3 = ac and thm.accent or Color3.fromRGB(68,68,82)
            end)
        end
        for _,ind in ipairs(_themeTabInds) do pcall(function() ind.BackgroundColor3=thm.accent end) end
        
        for _,tgl in ipairs(_themeToggleRefs) do pcall(function()
            if tgl.getSt() then
                tgl.track.BackgroundColor3=thm.accentBg
                tgl.knob.BackgroundColor3=thm.accent
                if tgl.trkStroke then tgl.trkStroke.Color=thm.accentDark end
            end
        end) end
        for _,ab in ipairs(_themeActBtns)  do
            pcall(function() ab.BackgroundColor3=thm.accentBg end)
            pcall(function() ab.TextColor3=thm.accent end)
        end
        for _,kb in ipairs(_themeKbLabels) do
            pcall(function() kb.BackgroundColor3=thm.accentBg end)
            pcall(function() kb.TextColor3=thm.accent end)
        end
        
        for _,s in ipairs(_themeSwatchStrokes) do
            local ac=(s.name==name)
            TweenService:Create(s.stroke,TweenInfo.new(0.15),{
                Color=ac and Color3.fromRGB(255,255,255) or Color3.fromRGB(60,60,70),
                Transparency=ac and 0.05 or 0.5, Thickness=ac and 2.5 or 1
            }):Play()
        end
        
        applyBackgroundImage()
        
        saveConfig()
    end

    do local b=mkSection(vi,"AVATAR",0)
    local packNames={}; for name in pairs(_GACC.extras.packs) do table.insert(packNames,name) end; table.sort(packNames)
    _GACC.extras.addDropdownRow(b,"Anim Pack",packNames,_GACC.extras.getPack(),1,function(name)
        _GACC.extras.setPack(name,false); task.spawn(function() _GACC.extras.applyPack(name) end); saveConfig()
    end)
    addToggleRow(b,"Headless",_GACC.extras.getHeadless(),2,nil,function(on) _GACC.extras.setHeadless(on,LP.Character); saveConfig() end)
    addToggleRow(b,"Korblox",_GACC.extras.getKorblox(),3,nil,function(on) _GACC.extras.setKorblox(on,LP.Character); saveConfig() end)

    do
        local accessorySection=mkSection(vi,"ACCESSORY PACK",1)
        local selectedAccessory = (_G.AccessoryPack and _G.AccessoryPack.GetCurrent and _G.AccessoryPack.GetCurrent()) or "Off"
        if selectedAccessory == "Off" then selectedAccessory = "v1" end

        local _,accessoryMasterVisual=addToggleRow(
            accessorySection,"Accessory Pack",
            (_G.AccessoryPack and _G.AccessoryPack.GetEnabled and _G.AccessoryPack.GetEnabled()) == true,
            1,nil,
            function(on)
                if not _G.AccessoryPack then return end
                if on then
                    _G.AccessoryPack.SetPack(selectedAccessory)
                    _G.AccessoryPack.SetEnabled(true)
                else
                    _G.AccessoryPack.SetEnabled(false)
                end
                saveConfig()
            end
        )
        _GACC.accessoryPackMasterVisual=accessoryMasterVisual

        local skinRows={}
        local skins={"v1","annalisa","v3"}

        local function refreshAccessorySkinVisual()
            for name,visual in pairs(skinRows) do
                if visual then visual(name == selectedAccessory) end
            end
        end

        for i,name in ipairs(skins) do
            local _,skinVisual=addToggleRow(
                accessorySection,"Skin "..name,
                name == selectedAccessory,
                i+1,nil,
                function(on)
                    if not on then
                        refreshAccessorySkinVisual()
                        return
                    end

                    selectedAccessory=name
                    refreshAccessorySkinVisual()

                    if _G.AccessoryPack then
                        _G.AccessoryPack.SetPack(name)
                        if _G.AccessoryPack.GetEnabled and _G.AccessoryPack.GetEnabled() then
                            _G.AccessoryPack.SetEnabled(true)
                        end
                    end
                    saveConfig()
                end
            )
            skinRows[name]=skinVisual
        end

        _GACC.accessoryPackSkinVisuals=skinRows
        refreshAccessorySkinVisual()

        if _G.AccessoryPack and _G.AccessoryPack.GetEnabled and _G.AccessoryPack.GetEnabled() then
            accessoryMasterVisual(true)
        end
    end
    end

-- VEXON MUSIC PLAYER TOGGLE
-- VEXON MUSIC PLAYER (integrated from the second uploaded file)

local function createVexonMusicPlayer()
    --[[
        Vexon Music Player - Integrated
        Berisi GUI Music Player + daftar lagu + speed + volume + stop.
        Diekstrak dari logic Music Player pada haveunpatchedspeed.txt.
    ]]

    local Players = game:GetService("Players")
    local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")
    local LocalPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer

    local parentGui
    pcall(function()
        parentGui = gethui()
    end)
    if not (parentGui and typeof(parentGui) == "Instance") then
        parentGui = LocalPlayer:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")
    end

    local function getAsset()
        if getcustomasset then return getcustomasset end
        if getsynasset then return getsynasset end
        return nil
    end

    pcall(function()
        local old = parentGui:FindFirstChild("VexonMusicPlayer")
        if old then old:Destroy() end

        local oldCore = game:GetService("CoreGui"):FindFirstChild("VexonMusicPlayer")
        if oldCore then oldCore:Destroy() end
    end)

    local ScreenGui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
    ScreenGui.Name = "VexonMusicPlayer"
    ScreenGui.ResetOnSpawn = false
    ScreenGui.IgnoreGuiInset = true
    ScreenGui.ZIndexBehavior = Enum.ZIndexBehavior.Global
    ScreenGui.DisplayOrder = 9999
    ScreenGui.Parent = parentGui

    local Frame = Instance.new("Frame")
    Frame.Size = UDim2.new(0, 320, 0, 348)
    Frame.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -160, 0.5, -174)
    Frame.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(11, 9, 20)
    Frame.BackgroundTransparency = 0.08
    Frame.BorderSizePixel = 0
    Frame.Active = true
    Frame.ClipsDescendants = true
    Frame.Parent = ScreenGui
    Frame.Visible = false

    Instance.new("UICorner", Frame).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 14)

    local stroke = Instance.new("UIStroke")
    stroke.Thickness = 1.4
    stroke.ApplyStrokeMode = Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border
    stroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(168, 85, 247)
    stroke.Parent = Frame

    local gradient = Instance.new("UIGradient")
    gradient.Color = ColorSequence.new({
        ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0, Color3.fromRGB(168, 85, 247)),
        ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.33, Color3.fromRGB(0, 230, 255)),
        ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.66, Color3.fromRGB(247, 37, 133)),
        ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(1, Color3.fromRGB(168, 85, 247)),
    })
    gradient.Parent = stroke

    local Header = Instance.new("Frame")
    Header.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 40)
    Header.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(16, 13, 28)
    Header.BackgroundTransparency = 0.3
    Header.BorderSizePixel = 0
    Header.Active = true
    Header.ZIndex = 2
    Header.Parent = Frame
    Instance.new("UICorner", Header).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 14)

    local Dot = Instance.new("Frame")
    Dot.Size = UDim2.new(0, 7, 0, 7)
    Dot.Position = UDim2.new(0, 14, 0.5, -3)
    Dot.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 230, 255)
    Dot.BorderSizePixel = 0
    Dot.ZIndex = 3
    Dot.Parent = Header
    Instance.new("UICorner", Dot).CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)

    local Title = Instance.new("TextLabel")
    Title.Size = UDim2.new(1, -60, 1, 0)
    Title.Position = UDim2.new(0, 28, 0, 0)
    Title.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    Title.Text = "ZenVyx MUSIC"
    Title.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
    Title.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBlack
    Title.TextSize = 13
    Title.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
    Title.ZIndex = 3
    Title.Parent = Header

    local Close = Instance.new("TextButton")
    Close.Size = UDim2.new(0, 28, 0, 28)
    Close.Position = UDim2.new(1, -34, 0.5, -14)

    local Sound = Instance.new("Sound")
    Sound.Name = "VexonMusicSound"
    Sound.Volume = 0.6
    Sound.Parent = ScreenGui

    local function getSpeed()
        local n = tonumber(ScreenGui:GetAttribute("MusicSpeed")) or 1
        n = math.clamp(n, 0.5, 2)
        return math.floor(n * 10 + 0.5) / 10
    end

    ScreenGui:SetAttribute("MusicSpeed", 1)

    local songs = {
        {name = "vyzee we go up", url = "https://files.catbox.moe/bvpw7w.mp3", file = "vyzee.mp3"},
        {name = "balenciaga", url = "https://files.catbox.moe/n6mu6i.mp3", file = "balenciaga.mp3"},
        {name = "du bist", url = "https://files.catbox.moe/dwjk76.mp3", file = "dubist.mp3"},
        {name = "king nasir", url = "https://files.catbox.moe/dkci4j.mp3", file = "kingnasir.mp3"},
        {name = "blue bands", url = "https://files.catbox.moe/3g99za.mp3", file = "bluebands.mp3"},
        {name = "cool for the summer", url = "https://files.catbox.moe/wymx4d.mp3", file = "coolforthesummer.mp3"},
        {name = "cinderella", url = "https://files.catbox.moe/uvkpzb.mp3", file = "cinderella.mp3"},
        {name = "ghetto love story", url = "https://files.catbox.moe/tqunbw.mp3", file = "ghettolovestory.mp3"},
        {name = "nevada", url = "https://files.catbox.moe/wmnpw2.mp3", file = "nevada.mp3"},
        {name = "raya", url = "https://files.catbox.moe/uf7506.mp3", file = "raya.mp3"},
    }

    local ScrollingFrame = Instance.new("ScrollingFrame")
    ScrollingFrame.Size = UDim2.new(1, -20, 0, 182)
    ScrollingFrame.Position = UDim2.new(0, 10, 0, 46)
    ScrollingFrame.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    ScrollingFrame.BorderSizePixel = 0
    ScrollingFrame.ScrollBarThickness = 3
    ScrollingFrame.ScrollBarImageColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(140, 90, 240)
    ScrollingFrame.CanvasSize = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, #songs * 40 + 8)
    ScrollingFrame.ClipsDescendants = true
    ScrollingFrame.ZIndex = 2
    ScrollingFrame.Parent = Frame

    local currentFile
    local requestId = 0
    local buttons = {}

    local function updateSelection(index)
        for i, button in ipairs(buttons) do
            if index and i == index then
                button.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(18, 55, 36)
                button.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(140, 255, 190)
            else
                button.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(16, 13, 26)
                button.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(220, 220, 235)
            end
        end
    end

    local function playSong(song, index, button)
        if currentFile == song.file then
            requestId += 1
            pcall(function() Sound:Stop() end)
            currentFile = nil
            updateSelection(nil)
            return
        end

        requestId += 1
        local id = requestId
        updateSelection(nil)
        button.Text = "Loading..."

        task.spawn(function()
            local ok = pcall(function()
                local cached = false

                pcall(function()
                    if isfile and isfile(song.file) then
                        cached = true
                    end
                end)

                if not cached then
                    local body = game:HttpGet(song.url)
                    if writefile then
                        writefile(song.file, body)
                    else
                        error("writefile tidak tersedia")
                    end
                end

                if id ~= requestId then return end

                Sound:Stop()

                local asset = getAsset()
                if not asset then
                    error("getcustomasset/getsynasset tidak tersedia")
                end

                Sound.SoundId = asset(song.file)
                Sound.PlaybackSpeed = getSpeed()
                Sound:Play()
                currentFile = song.file
            end)

            if id ~= requestId then return end

            if ok then
                updateSelection(index)
                button.Text = song.name
            else
                button.Text = "Failed"
                task.wait(1.5)
                if id == requestId then
                    button.Text = song.name
                    updateSelection(nil)
                end
            end
        end)
    end

    for i, song in ipairs(songs) do
        local button = Instance.new("TextButton")
        button.Name = "MusicBtn" .. i
        button.Size = UDim2.new(1, -8, 0, 34)
        button.Position = UDim2.new(0, 4, 0, 4 + (i - 1) * 40)
        button.Text = song.name
        button.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(16, 13, 26)
        button.BackgroundTransparency = 0.25
        button.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(220, 220, 235)
        button.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
        button.TextSize = 11.5
        button.AutoButtonColor = true
        button.ZIndex = 3
        button.Parent = ScrollingFrame
        Instance.new("UICorner", button).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 8)

        local s = Instance.new("UIStroke")
        s.Thickness = 1
        s.Color = Color3.fromRGB(45, 38, 70)
        s.Parent = button

        buttons[i] = button
        button.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
            playSong(song, i, button)
        end)
    end

    Sound.Ended:Connect(function()
        updateSelection(nil)
    end)

    local SpdDown = Instance.new("TextButton")
    SpdDown.Name = "MusicSpdDown"
    SpdDown.Size = UDim2.new(0, 96, 0, 28)
    SpdDown.Position = UDim2.new(0, 10, 0, 238)
    SpdDown.Text = "Spd -"
    SpdDown.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(18, 15, 30)

    SpdLabel.Size = UDim2.new(0, 96, 0, 28)
    SpdLabel.Position = UDim2.new(0, 112, 0, 238)
    SpdLabel.Text = "Speed: 100%"
    SpdLabel.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(30, 18, 44)

    SpdLabel.TextSize = 12
    SpdLabel.ZIndex = 2
    SpdLabel.Parent = Frame
    Instance.new("UICorner", SpdLabel).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 8)

    local SpdUp = Instance.new("TextButton")
    SpdUp.Name = "MusicSpdUp"
    SpdUp.Size = UDim2.new(0, 96, 0, 28)
    SpdUp.Position = UDim2.new(0, 214, 0, 238)
    SpdUp.Text = "Spd +"
    SpdUp.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(18, 15, 30)
    SpdUp.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(220, 220, 240)
    SpdUp.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
    SpdUp.TextSize = 12
    SpdUp.ZIndex = 2
    SpdUp.Parent = Frame
    Instance.new("UICorner", SpdUp).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 8)

    local function refreshSpeed()
        local value = getSpeed()
        ScreenGui:SetAttribute("MusicSpeed", value)
        Sound.PlaybackSpeed = value
        SpdLabel.Text = "Speed: " .. tostring(math.floor(value * 100 + 0.5)) .. "%"
    end

    SpdDown.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
        ScreenGui:SetAttribute("MusicSpeed", getSpeed() - 0.1)
        refreshSpeed()
    end)

    SpdUp.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
        ScreenGui:SetAttribute("MusicSpeed", getSpeed() + 0.1)
        refreshSpeed()
    end)

    SpdLabel.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
        ScreenGui:SetAttribute("MusicSpeed", 1)
        refreshSpeed()
    end)

    local VolDown = Instance.new("TextButton")
    VolDown.Name = "MusicVolDown"
    VolDown.Size = UDim2.new(0.5, -14, 0, 28)
    VolDown.Position = UDim2.new(0, 10, 0, 274)
    VolDown.Text = "Vol -"
    VolDown.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(18, 15, 30)
    VolDown.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(220, 220, 240)
    VolDown.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
    VolDown.TextSize = 12
    VolDown.ZIndex = 2
    VolDown.Parent = Frame
    Instance.new("UICorner", VolDown).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 8)

    local VolUp = Instance.new("TextButton")
    VolUp.Name = "MusicVolUp"
    VolUp.Size = UDim2.new(0.5, -14, 0, 28)
    VolUp.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 4, 0, 274)
    VolUp.Text = "Vol +"
    VolUp.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(18, 15, 30)
    VolUp.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(220, 220, 240)
    VolUp.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
    VolUp.TextSize = 12
    VolUp.ZIndex = 2
    VolUp.Parent = Frame
    Instance.new("UICorner", VolUp).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 8)

    VolDown.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
        Sound.Volume = math.clamp(Sound.Volume - 0.1, 0, 1)
    end)

    VolUp.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
        Sound.Volume = math.clamp(Sound.Volume + 0.1, 0, 1)
    end)

    local Stop = Instance.new("TextButton")
    Stop.Name = "StopMusic"
    Stop.Size = UDim2.new(1, -20, 0, 28)
    Stop.Position = UDim2.new(0, 10, 0, 310)
    Stop.Text = "STOP MUSIC"
    Stop.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(48, 18, 32)
    Stop.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 180, 195)
    Stop.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
    Stop.TextSize = 11.5
    Stop.ZIndex = 2
    Stop.Parent = Frame
    Instance.new("UICorner", Stop).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 8)

    Stop.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
        requestId += 1
        pcall(function() Sound:Stop() end)
        currentFile = nil
        updateSelection(nil)
    end)

    Close.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
        Frame.Visible = false
    end)

    -- Drag support
    do
        local dragging = false
        local dragStart, startPos
        local dragInput

        local function update(input)
            local delta = input.Position - dragStart
            Frame.Position = UDim2.new(
                startPos.X.Scale, startPos.X.Offset + delta.X,
                startPos.Y.Scale, startPos.Y.Offset + delta.Y
            )
        end

        Header.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
            if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
                or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
                dragging = true
                dragStart = input.Position
                startPos = Frame.Position

                input.Changed:Connect(function()
                    if input.UserInputState == Enum.UserInputState.End then
                        dragging = false
                    end
                end)
            end
        end)

        Header.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
            if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement
                or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
                dragInput = input
            end
        end)

        game:GetService("UserInputService").InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
            if input == dragInput and dragging then
                update(input)
            end
        end)
    end

    refreshSpeed()

    -- Public controller returned to the host script.
    local function setVisible(on)
        if ScreenGui and ScreenGui.Parent then
            Frame.Visible = (on == true)
        end
    end

    local function toggleVisible()
        if ScreenGui and ScreenGui.Parent then
            Frame.Visible = not Frame.Visible
        end
    end

    return setVisible, toggleVisible, ScreenGui, Sound
end

local _setVexonMusicVisible, _toggleVexonMusicVisible, VexonMusicScreenGui, VexonMusicSound =

setVexonMusicVisible = _setVexonMusicVisible
_G.VexonMusicPlayerToggle = _toggleVexonMusicVisible
_G.VexonMusicPlayerGui = VexonMusicScreenGui
_G.VexonMusicSound = VexonMusicSound

if vexonMusicEnabled then
    setVexonMusicVisible(true)
else
    setVexonMusicVisible(false)
end



-- ============================================================
-- VEXON E01 NOTIFIER
-- Compact capsule notification.
-- Entry: from bottom. Exit: upward.
-- Border sweep completes one full lap in exactly 3.00 seconds.
-- ============================================================
do
    local E01Gui = nil
    local E01Connection = nil
    local e01WasCarrying = false

    local function e01GuiParent()
        if typeof(gethui) == "function" then
            local ok, result = pcall(gethui)
            if ok and result then return result end
        end
        local ok, core = pcall(function() return game:GetService("CoreGui") end)
        if ok and core then return core end
        return LP:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")
    end

    local function e01Cleanup()
        if E01Connection then
            pcall(function() E01Connection:Disconnect() end)
            E01Connection = nil
        end
        if E01Gui then
            pcall(function() E01Gui:Destroy() end)
            E01Gui = nil
        end
        local parent = e01GuiParent()
        local old = parent and parent:FindFirstChild("VexonE01Notifier")
        if old then pcall(function() old:Destroy() end) end
    end

    local function e01IsCarrying()
        local char = LP.Character
        if not char then return false end
        for _, child in ipairs(char:GetChildren()) do
            local name = string.lower(child.Name)
            if name:find("brainrot") or name:find("brain") or name:find("animal")
                or name:find("carry") or name:find("stolen") or name:find("held")
                or name:find("steal") then
                return true
            end
        end
        for attrName, attrValue in pairs(char:GetAttributes()) do
            local name = string.lower(attrName)
            if (name:find("carrying") or name:find("carry") or name:find("stealing")
                or name:find("isstealing") or name:find("hasbrainrot")) and attrValue == true then
                return true
            end
        end
        local humanoid = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        if humanoid and humanoid.WalkSpeed > 0 and humanoid.WalkSpeed <= 25 and humanoid.WalkSpeed ~= 16 then
            return true
        end
        return false
    end

    local function e01Show()
        e01Cleanup()
        local parent = e01GuiParent()
        if not parent then return end

        local gui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
        gui.Name = "VexonE01Notifier"
        gui.ResetOnSpawn = false
        gui.IgnoreGuiInset = true
        gui.ZIndexBehavior = Enum.ZIndexBehavior.Sibling
        gui.DisplayOrder = 9999
        gui.Parent = parent
        E01Gui = gui

        -- Compact capsule dimensions.
        local width, height = 520, 96
        local centerX = -width / 2
        local targetY = 34
        local enterY = 92
        local exitY = -96

        -- Soft shadow.
        local shadow = Instance.new("Frame")
        shadow.Name = "Shadow"
        shadow.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(width + 10, height + 8)
        shadow.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, centerX - 5, 0, enterY + 5)
        shadow.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0)
        shadow.BackgroundTransparency = 0.35
        shadow.BorderSizePixel = 0
        shadow.ZIndex = 1
        shadow.Parent = gui
        Instance.new("UICorner", shadow).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, height / 2 + 4)

        -- Main capsule.
        local frame = Instance.new("Frame")
        frame.Name = "StealBar"
        frame.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(width, height)
        frame.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, centerX, 0, enterY)
        frame.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(8, 8, 8)
        frame.BackgroundTransparency = 0.03
        frame.BorderSizePixel = 0
        frame.ZIndex = 3
        frame.Parent = gui
        Instance.new("UICorner", frame).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, height / 2)

        -- Base border.
        local stroke = Instance.new("UIStroke")
        stroke.Name = "BaseBorder"
        stroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(105, 105, 105)
        stroke.Thickness = 1.15
        stroke.Transparency = 0.15
        stroke.Parent = frame

        -- Moving border tracer. The UIGradient rotates once around the capsule
        -- during the exact same 3.00 second countdown.
        local sweepStroke = Instance.new("UIStroke")
        sweepStroke.Name = "StealBarSweep"
        sweepStroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
        sweepStroke.Thickness = 2.1
        sweepStroke.Transparency = 0.02
        sweepStroke.Parent = frame

        local sweepGradient = Instance.new("UIGradient")
        sweepGradient.Name = "PerimeterSweep"
        sweepGradient.Color = ColorSequence.new(Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255))
        sweepGradient.Transparency = NumberSequence.new({
            NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0.00, 1.00),
            NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0.38, 1.00),
            NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0.48, 0.05),
            NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0.52, 0.00),
            NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0.56, 0.05),
            NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0.66, 1.00),
            NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1.00, 1.00),
        })
        sweepGradient.Rotation = -90
        sweepGradient.Parent = sweepStroke

        -- Inner hairline gives the bar a cleaner polished look.
        local inner = Instance.new("Frame")
        inner.Size = UDim2.new(1, -10, 1, -10)
        inner.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(5, 5)
        inner.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        inner.BorderSizePixel = 0
        inner.ZIndex = 4
        inner.Parent = frame
        Instance.new("UICorner", inner).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, height / 2 - 5)
        local innerStroke = Instance.new("UIStroke")
        innerStroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(70, 70, 70)
        innerStroke.Thickness = 1
        innerStroke.Transparency = 0.6
        innerStroke.Parent = inner

        -- Left accent dot.
        local dot = Instance.new("Frame")
        dot.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(8, 8)
        dot.Position = UDim2.new(0, 17, 0.5, -4)
        dot.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
        dot.BorderSizePixel = 0
        dot.ZIndex = 6
        dot.Parent = frame
        Instance.new("UICorner", dot).CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)

        local brand = Instance.new("TextLabel")
        brand.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(58, 11)
        brand.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(31, 7)
        brand.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        brand.Text = "ZenVyx"
        brand.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(155, 155, 155)
        brand.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
        brand.TextSize = 10
        brand.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
        brand.ZIndex = 6
        brand.Parent = frame

        local title = Instance.new("TextLabel")
        title.Size = UDim2.new(1, -190, 0, 30)
        title.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(31, 21)
        title.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        title.Text = "DONT STEAL"
        title.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
        title.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBlack
        title.TextSize = 26
        title.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
        title.TextYAlignment = Enum.TextYAlignment.Center
        title.ZIndex = 6
        title.Parent = frame

        local sub = Instance.new("TextLabel")
        sub.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(125, 16)
        sub.Position = UDim2.new(1, -119, 0.5, -7)
        sub.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        sub.Text = "E01 CHECK  •  3.00s"
        sub.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(185, 185, 185)
        sub.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
        sub.TextSize = 11
        sub.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Right
        sub.ZIndex = 6
        sub.Parent = frame

        -- Enter from below.
        pcall(function()
            TweenService:Create(frame, TweenInfo.new(0.48, Enum.EasingStyle.Quart, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {
                Position = UDim2.new(0.5, centerX, 0, targetY)
            }):Play()
            TweenService:Create(shadow, TweenInfo.new(0.48, Enum.EasingStyle.Quart, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {
                Position = UDim2.new(0.5, centerX - 5, 0, targetY + 5)
            }):Play()
        end)

        local duration = 3.0
        local startTime = tick()
        local finished = false

        -- One exact 3.00 second perimeter lap.
        pcall(function()
            TweenService:Create(
                sweepGradient,
                TweenInfo.new(duration, Enum.EasingStyle.Linear, Enum.EasingDirection.InOut),
                {Rotation = 270}
            ):Play()
        end)

        E01Connection = RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
            if finished or not frame.Parent then
                if E01Connection then E01Connection:Disconnect(); E01Connection=nil end
                return
            end

            local elapsed = tick() - startTime
            local remaining = math.max(0, duration - elapsed)

            if remaining > 0 then
                sub.Text = string.format("E01 CHECK  •  %.2fs", remaining)
            else
                finished = true
                if E01Connection then E01Connection:Disconnect(); E01Connection=nil end

                title.Text = "STEAL NOW"
                title.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
                sub.Text = "SAFE  •  GO"
                sub.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
                sweepGradient.Transparency = NumberSequence.new(0)
                sweepStroke.Thickness = 2.35
                dot.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)

                -- Hold briefly, then exit upward like a real notification.
                task.delay(0.65, function()
                    if E01Gui ~= gui or not frame.Parent then return end
                    pcall(function()
                        TweenService:Create(frame, TweenInfo.new(0.42, Enum.EasingStyle.Quart, Enum.EasingDirection.In), {
                            Position = UDim2.new(0.5, centerX, 0, exitY),
                            BackgroundTransparency = 1
                        }):Play()
                        TweenService:Create(shadow, TweenInfo.new(0.42, Enum.EasingStyle.Quart, Enum.EasingDirection.In), {
                            Position = UDim2.new(0.5, centerX - 5, 0, exitY + 5),
                            BackgroundTransparency = 1
                        }):Play()
                    end)
                    task.delay(0.45, function()
                        if E01Gui == gui then
                            e01Cleanup()
                        end
                    end)
                end)
            end
        end)
    end

    -- Clean up an older notifier from a previous execute.
    e01Cleanup()

    task.spawn(function()
        while task.wait(0.1) do
            local carrying = e01IsCarrying()
            if not e01WasCarrying and carrying then
                pcall(e01Show)
            end
            e01WasCarrying = carrying
        end
    end)
end

-- ============================================================
-- VEXON ANTI DESYNC GUI + LOGIC
-- Integrated from the uploaded Fresh Anti TP / Anti Desync source.
-- Branding: VEXON. Theme: black + white.
-- ============================================================
do
    local ADS_BORDER = Color3.fromRGB(235,235,235)
    local ADS_PANEL = Color3.fromRGB(10,10,10)
    local ADS_TEXT = Color3.fromRGB(255,255,255)
    local ADS_SUB = Color3.fromRGB(175,175,175)
    local ADS_ON = Color3.fromRGB(255,255,255)
    local ADS_OFF = Color3.fromRGB(35,35,35)
    local ADS_WIDTH = 250
    local ADS_HEIGHT = 190
    local ADS_COLLAPSED_HEIGHT = 48
    local ADS_DEFAULT_WALK = 16
    local ADS_DEFAULT_JUMP = 50

    local adsDrag = false
    local adsDragStart = nil
    local adsStartPos = nil

    local function adsGetGuiParent()
        if typeof(gethui) == "function" then
            local ok, result = pcall(gethui)
            if ok and result then return result end
        end
        local ok, core = pcall(function() return game:GetService("CoreGui") end)
        if ok and core then return core end
        return LP:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")
    end

    local function adsDisconnect()
        for _, conn in ipairs(antiDesyncConnections) do
            pcall(function()
                if typeof(conn) == "RBXScriptConnection" then
                    conn:Disconnect()
                elseif typeof(conn) == "thread" then
                    task.cancel(conn)
                end
            end)
        end
        antiDesyncConnections = {}
    end

    local function adsApplyToPlayers()
        if not antiDesyncEnabled then return end
        for _, plr in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
            if plr ~= LP then
                local char = plr.Character
                if char then
                    local hum = char:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("Humanoid")
                    if hum then
                        pcall(function() hum.WalkSpeed = 0 end)
                        pcall(function() hum.JumpPower = 0 end)
                        pcall(function() hum.AutoRotate = false end)
                    end
                    for _, part in ipairs(char:GetDescendants()) do
                        if part:IsA("BasePart") then
                            pcall(function() part.CanCollide = false end)
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end

    local function adsRestorePlayers()
        for _, plr in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
            if plr ~= LP then
                local char = plr.Character
                if char then
                    local hum = char:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("Humanoid")
                    if hum then
                        pcall(function() hum.WalkSpeed = ADS_DEFAULT_WALK end)
                        pcall(function() hum.JumpPower = ADS_DEFAULT_JUMP end)
                        pcall(function() hum.AutoRotate = true end)
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end

    local function adsStartLogic()
        antiDesyncEnabled = true
        adsDisconnect()

        local steppedConn = RunService.Stepped:Connect(function()
            if not antiDesyncEnabled then return end
            adsApplyToPlayers()
        end)
        table.insert(antiDesyncConnections, steppedConn)

        local playerConn = Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(function(plr)
            if not antiDesyncEnabled then return end
            local charConn
            charConn = plr.CharacterAdded:Connect(function()
                if not antiDesyncEnabled then
                    pcall(function() charConn:Disconnect() end)
                    return
                end
                task.wait(0.15)
                adsApplyToPlayers()
            end)
            table.insert(antiDesyncConnections, charConn)
            if plr.Character then
                task.defer(adsApplyToPlayers)
            end
        end)
        table.insert(antiDesyncConnections, playerConn)

        local charWatchers = {}
        for _, plr in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
            if plr ~= LP then
                local conn = plr.CharacterAdded:Connect(function()
                    if antiDesyncEnabled then
                        task.wait(0.15)
                        adsApplyToPlayers()
                    end
                end)
                table.insert(charWatchers, conn)
            end
        end
        for _, conn in ipairs(charWatchers) do
            table.insert(antiDesyncConnections, conn)
        end

        adsApplyToPlayers()
    end

    local function adsStopLogic()
        antiDesyncEnabled = false
        adsDisconnect()
        adsRestorePlayers()
    end

    local function adsSetGuiVisible(on)
        antiDesyncGuiVisible = (on == true)
        if antiDesyncGui and antiDesyncGui.Parent then
            antiDesyncGui.Enabled = antiDesyncGuiVisible
        end
        if _GACC.antiDesyncGuiVisual then
            pcall(function() _GACC.antiDesyncGuiVisual(antiDesyncGuiVisible) end)
        end
        saveConfig()
    end

    local function adsUpdateVisuals()
        if not antiDesyncMain or not antiDesyncMain.Parent then return end
        local statusVal = antiDesyncMain:FindFirstChild("StatusValue", true)
        local statusDot = antiDesyncMain:FindFirstChild("StatusDot", true)
        local track = antiDesyncMain:FindFirstChild("ToggleTrack", true)
        local knob = antiDesyncMain:FindFirstChild("ToggleKnob", true)
        if not statusVal or not statusDot or not track or not knob then return end
        local on = antiDesyncEnabled == true
        statusVal.Text = on and "ACTIVE" or "INACTIVE"
        statusVal.TextColor3 = on and ADS_ON or ADS_SUB
        statusDot.BackgroundColor3 = on and ADS_ON or ADS_SUB
        track.BackgroundColor3 = on and Color3.fromRGB(55,55,55) or ADS_OFF
        knob.BackgroundColor3 = ADS_ON
        knob.Position = on and UDim2.new(1,-21,0.5,-8) or UDim2.new(0,3,0.5,-8)
    end

    pcall(function()
        local oldGui = game:GetService("CoreGui"):FindFirstChild("VexonAntiDesyncUI")
        if oldGui then oldGui:Destroy() end
    end)
    pcall(function()
        local pg = LP:FindFirstChildOfClass("PlayerGui")
        local oldGui = pg and pg:FindFirstChild("VexonAntiDesyncUI")
        if oldGui then oldGui:Destroy() end
    end)

    local adsHeader = Instance.new("Frame")
    adsHeader.Size = UDim2.new(1,0,0,42)
    adsHeader.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    adsHeader.ZIndex = 41
    adsHeader.Parent = antiDesyncMain

    local adsTitle = Instance.new("TextLabel")

    adsTitle.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(14,6)
    adsTitle.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    adsTitle.Text = "ANTI DESYNC"
    adsTitle.TextColor3 = ADS_TEXT
    adsTitle.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBlack

    adsSub.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(14,25)
    adsSub.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    adsSub.Text = "ZenVyx"
    adsSub.TextColor3 = ADS_SUB
    adsSub.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
    adsSub.TextSize = 9
    adsSub.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
    adsSub.ZIndex = 42
    adsSub.Parent = adsHeader

    local adsMin = Instance.new("TextButton")
    adsMin.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(24,24)
    adsMin.Position = UDim2.new(1,-34,0,9)
    adsMin.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(20,20,20)
    adsMin.Text = "-"
    adsMin.TextColor3 = ADS_TEXT
    adsMin.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBlack
    adsMin.TextSize = 16
    adsMin.ZIndex = 42
    adsMin.Parent = adsHeader
    guiCorner(adsMin, 6)

    local adsCollapsed = false
    adsMin.Activated:Connect(function()
        adsCollapsed = not adsCollapsed

            {Size = UDim2.fromOffset(ADS_WIDTH, target)}
        ):Play()
    end)

    -- Drag window
    antiDesyncMain.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
        if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
        or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
            adsDrag = true
            adsDragStart = input.Position
            adsStartPos = antiDesyncMain.Position
            input.Changed:Connect(function()
                if input.UserInputState == Enum.UserInputState.End then
                    adsDrag = false
                end
            end)
        end
    end)

    UIS.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
        if not adsDrag then return end
        if input.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement
        and input.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.Touch then return end
        local dx = input.Position.X - adsDragStart.X
        local dy = input.Position.Y - adsDragStart.Y
        antiDesyncMain.Position = UDim2.new(
            adsStartPos.X.Scale,
            adsStartPos.X.Offset + dx,
            adsStartPos.Y.Scale,
            adsStartPos.Y.Offset + dy
        )
    end)

    local statusPanel = Instance.new("Frame")
    statusPanel.Size = UDim2.new(1,-24,0,34)
    statusPanel.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(12,48)
    statusPanel.BackgroundColor3 = ADS_PANEL
    statusPanel.BackgroundTransparency = 0.1
    statusPanel.BorderSizePixel = 0
    statusPanel.ZIndex = 41
    statusPanel.Parent = antiDesyncMain
    guiCorner(statusPanel, 9)
    guiStroke(statusPanel, Color3.fromRGB(45,45,45), 1)

    local statusDot = Instance.new("Frame")
    statusDot.Name = "StatusDot"
    statusDot.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(8,8)
    statusDot.Position = UDim2.new(0,12,0.5,-4)
    statusDot.BackgroundColor3 = ADS_SUB
    statusDot.BorderSizePixel = 0
    statusDot.ZIndex = 42
    statusDot.Parent = statusPanel
    guiCorner(statusDot, 4)

    local statusLbl = Instance.new("TextLabel")
    statusLbl.Size = UDim2.new(0,80,1,0)
    statusLbl.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(28,0)
    statusLbl.BackgroundTransparency = 1

    statusLbl.TextColor3 = ADS_TEXT
    statusLbl.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
    statusLbl.TextSize = 11
    statusLbl.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left

    local statusVal = Instance.new("TextLabel")

        GetEnabled = function() return antiDesyncEnabled == true end,
        SetGuiVisible = function(on) adsSetGuiVisible(on) end,
        GetGuiVisible = function() return antiDesyncGuiVisible == true end
    }

        task.defer(function()
            if antiDesyncEnabled then adsStartLogic(); adsUpdateVisuals() end
        end)
    end
