-- ============================================================
-- VEXON ANTI DIE GUI + LOGIC
-- Integrated from the uploaded "anti die.txt" source.
-- The feature state and GUI visibility use Dice_Mobile.json.
-- ============================================================
do
    local AD_BORDER = Color3.fromRGB(180,180,180)
    local AD_PANEL = Color3.fromRGB(15,15,15)
    local AD_TEXT = Color3.fromRGB(255,255,255)
    local AD_SUB = Color3.fromRGB(200,200,200)
    local AD_RED = Color3.fromRGB(255,80,100)
    local AD_GREEN = Color3.fromRGB(100,255,120)
    local AD_TOGGLE_ON = Color3.fromRGB(200,200,200)
    local AD_TOGGLE_OFF = Color3.fromRGB(40,40,40)
    local AD_WIDTH = 250
    local AD_EXPANDED_HEIGHT = 195
    local AD_COLLAPSED_HEIGHT = 50

    local function adDestroyBillboard()
        if antiDieBillboardUpdater then
            pcall(function() antiDieBillboardUpdater:Disconnect() end)
            antiDieBillboardUpdater=nil
        end
        if antiDieBillboardGui then
            pcall(function() antiDieBillboardGui:Destroy() end)
            antiDieBillboardGui=nil
        end
        antiDieBillboardFrame=nil
    end

    local function adCreateBillboard(char)
        if not char then return end
        local head=char:FindFirstChild("Head")
        if not head then return end
        adDestroyBillboard()

        antiDieBillboardGui=Instance.new("ScreenGui")
        antiDieBillboardGui.Name="VexonAntiDieBillboard"
        antiDieBillboardGui.ResetOnSpawn=false
        antiDieBillboardGui.IgnoreGuiInset=true
        antiDieBillboardGui.ZIndexBehavior=Enum.ZIndexBehavior.Sibling
        local core=game:GetService("CoreGui")
        local ok=pcall(function() antiDieBillboardGui.Parent=core end)
        if not ok or not antiDieBillboardGui.Parent then
            antiDieBillboardGui.Parent=LP:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")
        end

        antiDieBillboardFrame=Instance.new("Frame",antiDieBillboardGui)
        antiDieBillboardFrame.Size=UDim2.new(0,200,0,60)
        antiDieBillboardFrame.BackgroundColor3=Color3.fromRGB(0,0,0)
        antiDieBillboardFrame.BackgroundTransparency=.3
        antiDieBillboardFrame.BorderSizePixel=0
        antiDieBillboardFrame.Position=UDim2.new(.5,-100,.5,-30)
        guiCorner(antiDieBillboardFrame,8)

        local t1=Instance.new("TextLabel",antiDieBillboardFrame)
        t1.Size=UDim2.new(1,0,.5,0);t1.BackgroundTransparency=1;t1.Text="ANTI DIE"
        t1.TextColor3=AD_TEXT;t1.Font=Enum.Font.GothamBlack;t1.TextSize=20
        t1.TextXAlignment=Enum.TextXAlignment.Center;t1.TextYAlignment=Enum.TextYAlignment.Bottom

        local t2=Instance.new("TextLabel",antiDieBillboardFrame)
        t2.Size=UDim2.new(1,0,.5,0);t2.Position=UDim2.new(0,0,.5,0)
        t2.BackgroundTransparency=1;t2.Text="ZenVyx";t2.TextColor3=AD_TEXT
        t2.Font=Enum.Font.GothamBold;t2.TextSize=14;t2.TextXAlignment=Enum.TextXAlignment.Center
        t2.TextYAlignment=Enum.TextYAlignment.Top

        antiDieBillboardUpdater=RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
            if not antiDieBillboardGui or not antiDieBillboardGui.Parent or not antiDieBillboardFrame then
                adDestroyBillboard(); return
            end
            if not head or not head.Parent then
                antiDieBillboardFrame.Visible=false; return
            end
            local cam=workspace.CurrentCamera
            if not cam then antiDieBillboardFrame.Visible=false; return end
            local pos,onScreen=cam:WorldToScreenPoint(head.Position)
            if onScreen then
                antiDieBillboardFrame.Position=UDim2.new(0,pos.X-100,0,pos.Y-40)
                antiDieBillboardFrame.Visible=true
            else
                antiDieBillboardFrame.Visible=false
            end
        end)
    end

    local function adUpdateVisuals()
        if not antiDieMain or not antiDieMain.Parent then return end
        local dot=antiDieMain:FindFirstChild("ToggleDot",true)
        local bg=antiDieMain:FindFirstChild("ToggleBg",true)
        local statusVal=antiDieMain:FindFirstChild("StatusValue",true)
        local statusDot=antiDieMain:FindFirstChild("StatusDot",true)
        if not dot or not bg or not statusVal or not statusDot then return end
        local on=antiDieEnabled==true
        statusVal.Text=on and "ACTIVE" or "INACTIVE"
        statusVal.TextColor3=on and AD_GREEN or AD_RED
        statusDot.BackgroundColor3=on and AD_GREEN or AD_RED
        bg.BackgroundColor3=on and AD_TOGGLE_ON or AD_TOGGLE_OFF
        tw(dot,{Position=on and UDim2.new(1,-21,0.5,-8) or UDim2.new(0,3,0.5,-8)})
    end

    local function adStopProtectionConnections()
        for _,c in ipairs(antiDieDeathConns) do pcall(function() c:Disconnect() end) end
        antiDieDeathConns={}
        if antiDieHeartConn then pcall(function() antiDieHeartConn:Disconnect() end);antiDieHeartConn=nil end
        if antiDieCharAddedConn then pcall(function() antiDieCharAddedConn:Disconnect() end);antiDieCharAddedConn=nil end
    end

    local function adProtectChar(char)
        if not char or not antiDieEnabled then return end
        local hum=char:WaitForChild("Humanoid",5)
        if not hum then return end

        pcall(function() hum.MaxHealth=math.huge end)
        pcall(function() hum.Health=hum.MaxHealth end)
        pcall(function() hum:SetStateEnabled(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Dead,false) end)

        local stateConn=hum.StateChanged:Connect(function(_,newState)
            if not antiDieEnabled or not hum or not hum.Parent then return end
            if newState==Enum.HumanoidStateType.Dead then
                pcall(function() hum.Health=math.huge end)
                pcall(function() hum:SetStateEnabled(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Dead,false) end)
            end
        end)
        table.insert(antiDieDeathConns,stateConn)

        local healthConn=hum:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Health"):Connect(function()
            if not antiDieEnabled or not hum or not hum.Parent then return end
            local st=hum:GetState()
            if hum.Health < hum.MaxHealth and st~=Enum.HumanoidStateType.Dead then
                pcall(function() hum.Health=hum.MaxHealth end)
            end
        end)
        table.insert(antiDieDeathConns,healthConn)

        if antiDieHeartConn then pcall(function() antiDieHeartConn:Disconnect() end) end
        antiDieHeartConn=RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
            if not antiDieEnabled then return end
            if hum and hum.Parent and hum.Health < hum.MaxHealth then
                pcall(function() hum.Health=math.huge end)
            end
        end)

        adCreateBillboard(char)
    end

    startAntiDie=function()
        antiDieEnabled=true
        adStopProtectionConnections()
        local char=LP.Character
        if char then adProtectChar(char) end
        antiDieCharAddedConn=LP.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(c)
            if not antiDieEnabled then return end
            task.wait(.1)
            -- Disconnect only old Humanoid connections; keep this CharacterAdded connection alive.
            for _,conn in ipairs(antiDieDeathConns) do pcall(function() conn:Disconnect() end) end
            antiDieDeathConns={}
            if antiDieHeartConn then pcall(function() antiDieHeartConn:Disconnect() end);antiDieHeartConn=nil end
            if antiDieEnabled then adProtectChar(c) end
        end)
        adUpdateVisuals()
        saveConfig()
    end

    stopAntiDie=function()
        antiDieEnabled=false
        adStopProtectionConnections()
        adDestroyBillboard()
        adUpdateVisuals()
        saveConfig()
    end

    setAntiDieGuiVisible=function(on)
        antiDieGuiVisible=on==true
        if antiDieGui and antiDieGui.Parent then
            antiDieGui.Enabled=antiDieGuiVisible
        end
        if _GACC.antiDieGuiVisual then
            pcall(function() _GACC.antiDieGuiVisual(antiDieGuiVisible) end)
        end
        saveConfig()
    end

    end

        bar.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(3, 34)
        bar.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(8, 14)
        bar.BackgroundColor3 = _GACC.accent or Color3.fromRGB(255,55,70)
        bar.BorderSizePixel = 0
        bar.ZIndex = 4
        guiCorner(bar, 2)

        local t = Instance.new("TextLabel", card)
        t.Size = UDim2.new(1,-32,0,18)
        t.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(20, 10)
        t.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        t.Text = title
        t.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(245,245,250)
        t.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBlack
        t.TextSize = 12
        t.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
        t.ZIndex = 5

        local m = Instance.new("TextLabel", card)
        m.Size = UDim2.new(1,-32,0,22)
        m.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(20, 29)
        m.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        m.Text = message
        m.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(160,165,180)
        m.Font = Enum.Font.Gotham
        m.TextSize = 9
        m.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
        m.TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd
        m.ZIndex = 5

        local scale = Instance.new("UIScale", card)
        scale.Scale = 0.94

        TweenService:Create(card, TweenInfo.new(.35, Enum.EasingStyle.Quint, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {
            Position = UDim2.new(1, -316, 0, 76)
        }):Play()
        TweenService:Create(scale, TweenInfo.new(.35, Enum.EasingStyle.Back, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {
            Scale = 1
        }):Play()

        task.delay(duration, function()
            if not gui.Parent then return end
            local tw = TweenService:Create(card, TweenInfo.new(.28, Enum.EasingStyle.Quint, Enum.EasingDirection.In), {
                Position = UDim2.new(1, 18, 0, 76),
                BackgroundTransparency = 1
            })
            tw:Play()
            tw.Completed:Connect(function()
                pcall(function() gui:Destroy() end)
            end)
        end)
    end

    _G.MornexNotify = safeNotify

    task.delay(0.65, function()
        pcall(function()
            safeNotify("ZenVyx", "Midnight Blue + Ice Cyan loaded", 3.2)
        end)
    end)
end


-- ============================================================
-- ZENVYX COSMETIC PATCH: FLAT BLACK / MIDNIGHT BLUE / ICE CYAN
-- UI-only additions; gameplay functions above are left unchanged.
-- ============================================================
task.spawn(function()
    local Players = game:GetService("Players")
    local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")
    local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
    local SoundService = game:GetService("SoundService")
    local Debris = game:GetService("Debris")
    local LP = Players.LocalPlayer
    if not LP then return end
    local PG = LP:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")

    local BLACK = Color3.fromRGB(4, 5, 10)
    local MIDNIGHT = Color3.fromRGB(10, 20, 48)
    local MIDNIGHT2 = Color3.fromRGB(15, 34, 73)
    local CYAN = Color3.fromRGB(0, 220, 255)
    local ICE = Color3.fromRGB(155, 245, 255)
    local WHITE = Color3.fromRGB(230, 246, 255)

    -- Separate KryzenX sounds: GUI menu click and mobile action button click.
    local function playZenVyxGuiClick()
        pcall(function()
            local snd = Instance.new("Sound")
            snd.SoundId = "rbxassetid://6042053626"
            snd.Volume = 0.65
            snd.Parent = SoundService
            snd:Play()
            Debris:AddItem(snd, 2)
        end)
    end
    local function playZenVyxMobileClick()
        pcall(function()
            local snd = Instance.new("Sound")
            snd.SoundId = "rbxassetid://5852470908"
            snd.Volume = 0.4
            snd.Parent = SoundService
            snd:Play()
            Debris:AddItem(snd, 2)
        end)
    end
    _G.ZenVyxPlayGuiClick = playZenVyxGuiClick
    _G.ZenVyxPlayMobileClick = playZenVyxMobileClick

    -- Flat GUI background: disable image backgrounds and force a dark solid base.
    local function restyleRoot(root)
        if not root then return end
        pcall(function()
            if root.Name == "ZenVyxIntro" then return end
            for _, obj in ipairs(root:GetDescendants()) do
                if obj:IsA("ImageLabel") or obj:IsA("ImageButton") then
                    local n = string.lower(obj.Name)
                    -- Keep ZenVyx's requested GUI background visible; only hide unrelated image overlays.
                    if obj.Name == "BackgroundImage" and obj.Parent and obj.Parent.Name == "BackgroundContainer" then
                        obj.Visible = true
                        obj.ImageTransparency = 0
                        obj.ZIndex = 2
                        if bgImageContainer then bgImageContainer.Visible = true end
                        if bgImageRef == obj and applyBackgroundImage then
                            pcall(applyBackgroundImage)
                        end
                    elseif n:find("background") or n:find("bgimage") or n:find("wallpaper") then
                        obj.Visible = false
                    end
                elseif obj:IsA("Frame") then
                    local n = string.lower(obj.Name)
                    if n == "inner" or n == "bggrad" or n == "background" or n == "backgroundcontainer" then
                        obj.BackgroundColor3 = BLACK
                        if n == "backgroundcontainer" then obj.BackgroundTransparency = 1 end
                    end
                end
            end
        end)
    end

    -- Subtle orbital rings / black-hole particles, with no input-blocking overlay.
    local function addBlackHoleEffect(target, mobile)
        if not target or not target.Parent or target:GetAttribute("ZenVyxBlackHoleFX") then return end
        target:SetAttribute("ZenVyxBlackHoleFX", true)
        pcall(function()
            target.ClipsDescendants = true
            local ring = Instance.new("Frame")
            ring.Name = "ZenVyxBlackHoleOrbit"
            ring.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(.5,.5)
            ring.Position = UDim2.fromScale(.5,.5)
            ring.Size = mobile and UDim2.new(.72,0,.72,0) or UDim2.new(.16,0,.30,0)
            ring.BackgroundColor3 = BLACK
            ring.BackgroundTransparency = 1
            ring.BorderSizePixel = 0
            ring.ZIndex = (target.ZIndex or 1) + 3
            ring.Active = false
            pcall(function() ring.Interactable = false end)
            ring.Parent = target
            Instance.new("UICorner", ring).CornerRadius = UDim.new(1,0)
            local stroke = Instance.new("UIStroke", ring)
            stroke.Color = CYAN
            stroke.Thickness = mobile and 1.5 or 1
            stroke.Transparency = .28
            local grad = Instance.new("UIGradient", stroke)
            grad.Color = ColorSequence.new({
                ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0, CYAN),
                ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(.5, MIDNIGHT2),
                ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(1, ICE)
            })
            task.spawn(function()
                while ring.Parent and target.Parent do
                    local tw = TweenService:Create(ring, TweenInfo.new(3.4, Enum.EasingStyle.Linear), {
                        Rotation = ring.Rotation + 360,
                        Size = mobile and UDim2.new(.9,0,.9,0) or UDim2.new(.2,0,.38,0)
                    })
                    tw:Play()
                    tw.Completed:Wait()
                    if ring.Parent then
                        ring.Size = mobile and UDim2.new(.72,0,.72,0) or UDim2.new(.16,0,.30,0)
                    end
                end
            end)
            for i = 1, (mobile and 5 or 7) do
                local dot = Instance.new("Frame")
                dot.Name = "ZenVyxOrbitParticle"
                dot.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(.5,.5)
                dot.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(mobile and 3 or 2, mobile and 3 or 2)
                dot.Position = UDim2.fromScale(math.random(18,82)/100, math.random(18,82)/100)
                dot.BackgroundColor3 = (i % 2 == 0) and ICE or CYAN
                dot.BackgroundTransparency = .18
                dot.BorderSizePixel = 0
                dot.ZIndex = ring.ZIndex + 1
                dot.Active = false
                pcall(function() dot.Interactable = false end)
                dot.Parent = target
                Instance.new("UICorner", dot).CornerRadius = UDim.new(1,0)
                task.spawn(function()
                    while dot.Parent and target.Parent do
                        local nx = math.clamp(dot.Position.X.Scale + (math.random(-18,18)/100), .12, .88)
                        local ny = math.clamp(dot.Position.Y.Scale + (math.random(-18,18)/100), .12, .88)
                        local tw = TweenService:Create(dot, TweenInfo.new(math.random(12,24)/10, Enum.EasingStyle.Sine, Enum.EasingDirection.InOut), {
                            Position = UDim2.fromScale(nx,ny),
                            BackgroundTransparency = math.random(15,55)/100
                        })
                        tw:Play()
                        tw.Completed:Wait()
                    end
                end)
            end
        end)
    end

    local hooked = setmetatable({}, {__mode="k"})
    local function styleButton(btn, isMobile)
        if not btn or not (btn:IsA("TextButton") or btn:IsA("ImageButton")) then return end
        pcall(function()
            btn.AutoButtonColor = false
            if isMobile then
                btn.BackgroundColor3 = BLACK
                local g = btn:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIGradient")
                if not g then g = Instance.new("UIGradient"); g.Parent = btn end
                g.Color = ColorSequence.new({
                    ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0, BLACK),
                    ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(.52, MIDNIGHT),
                    ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(1, CYAN)
                })
                g.Rotation = 35
                addBlackHoleEffect(btn, true)
                if not btn:GetAttribute("ZenVyxMobileSoundHooked") then
                    btn:SetAttribute("ZenVyxMobileSoundHooked", true)
                    btn.Activated:Connect(playZenVyxMobileClick)
                end
            elseif not hooked[btn] then
                if btn:IsDescendantOf(PG) or btn:IsDescendantOf(game:GetService("CoreGui")) then
                    btn.Activated:Connect(playZenVyxGuiClick)
                end
            end
            hooked[btn] = true
        end)
    end

    local function applyAll()
        -- Theme variables used by the existing UI.
        pcall(function()
            if type(_GACC) == "table" then
                _GACC.accent = CYAN
                _GACC.accentDark = MIDNIGHT2
                _GACC.bg = BLACK
                _GACC.bgDark = BLACK
                _GACC.panel = MIDNIGHT
                _GACC.stroke = MIDNIGHT2
                _GACC.text = WHITE
            end
            if type(C) == "table" then
                C.bg = BLACK
                C.bgDark = BLACK
                C.panel = MIDNIGHT
                C.accent = CYAN
            end
            -- Keep the selected background visible; the previous theme pass hid it on every execute.
            if bgImageContainer then bgImageContainer.Visible = true end
            if bgImageRef then
                bgImageRef.Visible = true
                if applyBackgroundImage then pcall(applyBackgroundImage) end
            end
            backgroundEnabled = true
            if (tonumber(backgroundIndex) or 0) <= 0 then backgroundIndex = 1 end
        end)
        for _, root in ipairs(PG:GetChildren()) do
            if root:IsA("ScreenGui") and root.Name ~= "ZenVyxIntro" then
                restyleRoot(root)
                for _, obj in ipairs(root:GetDescendants()) do
                    if obj:IsA("TextButton") or obj:IsA("ImageButton") then
                        local n = string.lower(obj.Name)
                        local mobile = n:find("mobile") or n:find("mobbtn") or n:find("actionbutton")
                        styleButton(obj, mobile ~= nil)
                    end
                end
            end
        end
        pcall(function()
            local cg = game:GetService("CoreGui")
            for _, root in ipairs(cg:GetChildren()) do
                if root:IsA("ScreenGui") and root.Name ~= "ZenVyxIntro" then
                    restyleRoot(root)
                    if root.Name == "MoveeStealBar" then
                        local bar = root:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("Frame", true)
                        if bar then
                            bar.BackgroundColor3 = BLACK
                            addBlackHoleEffect(bar, false)
                        end
                    end
                    for _, obj in ipairs(root:GetDescendants()) do
                        if obj:IsA("TextButton") or obj:IsA("ImageButton") then
                            local n = string.lower(obj.Name)
                            styleButton(obj, (n:find("mobile") or n:find("mobbtn") or n:find("actionbutton")) ~= nil)
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
        end)
        pcall(function()
            if GuiRefs and GuiRefs.inner then
                GuiRefs.inner.BackgroundColor3 = BLACK
                -- do NOT addBlackHoleEffect on Inner: overlays can block toggle clicks
            end
            if stealBarFrame then
                stealBarFrame.BackgroundColor3 = BLACK
                addBlackHoleEffect(stealBarFrame, false)
            end
            if mobBtnRefs then
                for _, item in pairs(mobBtnRefs) do
                    local btn = typeof(item) == "Instance" and item or (type(item)=="table" and (item.button or item.btn))
                    if btn and btn:IsA("GuiObject") then
                        if btn:IsA("TextButton") or btn:IsA("ImageButton") then styleButton(btn,true) else addBlackHoleEffect(btn,true) end
                    end
                end
            end
        end)
    end

    -- Keep the ping notification centered at the top; only the first call is allowed.
    pcall(function()
        if type(createPingNotificationLegacy) == "function" then
            createPingNotificationLegacy = function() return nil end
        end
    end)
    task.delay(1.2, applyAll)
    task.delay(4, applyAll)
    -- light refresh only; heavy loop removed so overlays don't keep stacking / blocking clicks
    task.spawn(function()
        while PG.Parent do
            task.wait(12)
            pcall(applyAll)
        end
    end)
end)
